entities.name: Polish–Soviet border agreement of August 1945
entities.label: Text
entities.summary: The Border Agreement between Poland and the USSR of 16 August 1945 established the borders between the Soviet Union (USSR) and the People's Republic of Poland. It was signed by the Provisional Government of National Unity formed by the Polish communists. According to the treaty, Poland officially accepted the ceding its pre-war Eastern territory to the USSR (Kresy) which was decided earlier in Yalta already. Some of the territory along the Curzon line, established by Stalin during the course of the war, was returned to Poland.
